serves: neither as defined, nearest problem 1. It trains one base model on all 30,000 CLEVR images (page 11), calls that same model once per position, and trains a ViT coordinator on its outputs (pages 2-4, 11). best_idea: Trains a ViT coordinator on the outputs of one frozen diffusion model so it can generate larger objects or satisfy more conditions than it saw in coordinator training.
